extraction.name: EgoLife Dataset
extraction.description: The EgoLife Dataset is a 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset. It features six participants living together for a week, capturing synchronized first-person and third-person videos along with multimodal signals like millimeter-wave radar and WiFi.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.citeAs: The EgoLife Team. EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant. arXiv:2503.03803v1, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Six volunteers resided in a custom-designed environment for a seven-day period, wearing Meta Aria glasses to capture multimodal egocentric videos, while 15 GoPro cameras and millimeter-wave radars recorded third-person perspectives and spatial/motion data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Experiments; Physical data collection; Direct measurement
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Due to storage limitations, the smart glasses were collected every three hours for data upload and storage clearance, creating an approximately one-hour recording gap during which participants were instructed to rest or limit activities.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: First-person multimodal egocentric videos from AI glasses, third-person videos from fixed indoor GoPro cameras, and synchronized multimodal signal data including millimeter-wave radars and WiFi signals.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators refined speech transcripts, provided continuous narrations by talking over slowed video clips, verified AI-generated visual-audio captions, and used AI-generated questions as inspiration to curate QA pairs, generate distractors, and annotate audio requirements and look-back times.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: AI-generated QA candidates underwent a rigorous selection and refinement process, filtering 100K candidates down to 1K for meticulous revision, resulting in a final curated set of 500 QA per participant; narrations were also reviewed and corrected.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: speech recognition (Whisper Large v3); open-source diarization algorithm (Whisper diarization); transcription tool; GPT-4o-mini; GPT-4o
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Sacrificing some generalizability (e.g., single language/scenario) due to a narrow setting; recordings are structured into three-hour segments due to storage limitations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset holds significant potential to enhance human-AI interaction in personalized assistance and context-aware applications, improving quality of life for individuals needing consistent support (e.g., the elderly or those with cognitive challenges), though it requires addressing privacy and ethical considerations to ensure user autonomy and trust.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Participant faces, bystanders' faces, and vehicle license plates were blurred to anonymize identities; sensitive audio segments containing private or potentially identifiable information were muted; frames containing sensitive screen content (e.g., passwords or personal data) were blurred.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Studying long-duration activities, interpersonal dynamics, and contextual interactions; advancing research in human behavior recognition, multimodal signal analysis, and human-machine interaction.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data cleaning and preprocessing included synchronizing video and signal data from multiple sources using timestamps, extracting and aligning multimodal signals (radar and WiFi) with video data, blurring all identifiable faces, sensitive visual data, and license plates for de-identification, and muting audio containing sensitive topics. Audio was also processed to enhance clarity, merged, diarized to differentiate speakers, and split into individual tracks.
